scope: One representative instruction-following scenario per plugin and an independent source-grounded question where knowledge was attached. All 53 current releases were invoked with an explicit selected plugin. Earlier attempts remain in chronological order.
evidence: The tested release was checked on its directory page. The sent user message linked to that plugin. Grading used the completed response, its actual clickable destinations and the recovered native source. An answer hash covers its captured visible text. Private conversations and original evidence are held by the owner.
limits: ChatGPT exposed no file-open telemetry. The results establish that the tested answers matched the selected sources. Image generation used the verified visual companion. The original PNG was unreadable directly. The no-upload control checks honest attribution. Planned functionality in under-construction tools was outside the demonstrated workflows.
